exclusions.source_text: May have a prior or concurrent second malignancy (other than the disease under study) which natural history or treatment is unlikely to interfere with any study endpoints of safety or the efficacy of the study treatment(s)
Participant must have eastern cooperative oncology group (ECOG) status of 0 or 1
Participants with child bearing potential should consider preservation of eggs prior to study treatment as anti-cancer treatments may impair fertility
prolonged corrected QT interval by Fridericia (QTcF) interval greater than (\>) 480 milliseconds (msec) or clinically significant cardiac arrhythmia or electrophysiologic disease

Congestive heart failure defined as NYHA class III-IV or hospitalization for congestive heart failure (CHF) (any New York Heart Association \[NYHA\] class) within 6 months of treatment initiation at Cycle 1/day 1 (C1D1)
exclusions.threshold: NYHA class III-IV or CHF hospitalization within 6 months

exclusions.source_text: baseline left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) below the institution's lower limit of normal at screening, as assessed by echocardiogram or multigated acquisition (MUGA) scan
exclusions.threshold: LVEF below institution's lower limit of normal

exclusions.source_text: Other clinically active liver disease of infectious origin

A participant must agree not to donate eggs (ova, oocytes) or freeze for future use for the purposes of assisted reproduction during the study and for a period of 6 months after receiving the last dose of study treatment.
